about: Store image specs, one source of truth for store-specs and store-check. Every value comes from the official page in source_url, read on checked_at. Do not add a value without a source.

requirement_values.required: Every target locale needs this slot
requirement_values.one_of: Every target locale needs at least one slot of the named group
requirement_values.when_present: Needed in every target locale only when this store folder has this slot in some locale (the app supports that device)
requirement_values.optional: Never required; checked only when present

ios.name: App Store
ios.locale_codes: App Store Connect locale codes (for example ko, en-US, ja). Folder names are not normalized.
ios.fallback_note: The source pages do not state that a locale without screenshots shows the primary language screenshots, so a missing slot in a non-base locale is reported as an issue.

iphone.label: iPhone screenshots
iphone.note: Required size per the source: 'At least one screenshot for iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display).' Each of the three sizes falls back to scaled screenshots of another: medium <- Face ID (large); Face ID (large) <- Dynamic Island (large); Dynamic Island (large) <- Face ID (large). So one of the three satisfies the requirement.

iphone-dynamic-island-large.label: iPhone with Dynamic Island (large display)
iphone-dynamic-island-large.source_quote: If screenshots with the accepted sizes aren't provided, scaled screenshots for iPhone with Face ID (large display) are used.

iphone-face-id-large.label: iPhone with Face ID (large display)
iphone-face-id-large.source_quote: Required if app runs on iPhone and screenshots for iPhone with Dynamic Island (large display) aren't provided.

iphone-dynamic-island-medium.label: iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display)
iphone-dynamic-island-medium.source_quote: To submit your app, you must provide screenshots for the following required display sizes: iPhone: At least one screenshot for iPhone with Dynamic Island (medium display).

ipad-13.label: iPad 13" display
ipad-13.source_quote: iPad (if your app supports iPadOS): At least one screenshot for iPad 13-inch display.

play.name: Google Play
play.locale_codes: Google Play language codes (for example ko-KR, en-US, ja-JP). Folder names are not normalized.
play.fallback_note: The source page does not state that a language without its own graphics shows the default language graphics, so a missing slot in a non-base locale is reported as an issue.

phone-screenshots.label: Phone screenshots
phone-screenshots.count_note: Source: 'a minimum of two screenshots across different device types to publish'. Only phone screenshots are modeled, so the 2 is applied to this slot.

recommended.note: To be eligible for recommendations in formats that use screenshots: at least four screenshots with minimum 1080px resolution (portrait 9:16, minimum 1080x1920px; landscape 16:9, minimum 1920x1080px).

phone-screenshots.source_quote: JPEG or 24-bit PNG (no alpha). Minimum dimension: 320px. Maximum dimension: 3840px. The maximum dimension of your screenshot can't be more than twice as long as the minimum dimension. You can add up to 8 screenshots for each supported device type.

feature-graphic.label: Feature graphic
feature-graphic.source_quote: You must provide a feature graphic to publish your store listing. JPEG or 24-bit PNG (no alpha). Dimensions: 1024px by 500px. Localize your graphic and branding text as appropriate for different markets and languages.

app-icon.label: App icon
app-icon.localized_note: The source page does not say the icon is set per language; it is checked once under _global.
app-icon.source_quote: You must provide an app icon to publish your store listing. 32-bit PNG (with alpha). Dimensions: 512px by 512px. Maximum file size: 1024KB.
